title: 1 Kings 17:20-22 — Elijah prays and the widow's son revives
summary: The text of 1 Kings 17:20-22: Elijah cries to the LORD, stretches himself on the child three times, and prays for the child's life to return; the LORD hears his voice and the child revives. The names LORD, God, You and Elijah are lettered in colours.

text.text: 20 He called to the LORD and said, “O LORD my God, have You also brought calamity to the widow with whom I am staying, by causing her son to die?”
21 Then he stretched himself upon the child three times, and called to the LORD and said, “O LORD my God, I pray You, let this child’s life return to him.”
22 The LORD heard the voice of Elijah, and the life of the child returned to him and he revived.
